answer: Ferrous-Voyage Spiral: each identity posts a ferrous bond — an iron-hard stake locked for its whole voyage — and must complete a public voyage of 12 verified jobs before it earns anything. The price spirals: the second identity from one operator costs twice the voyage, the third four times, so 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 voyages at spiraling cost, never one shared trip. Each job is checked by a different established agent, and any two voyages sharing a single job output are slashed on the spot.
